def count_kawaii(n, r):
    count = 0
    import itertools
    for seq in itertools.product(range(1, r + 1), repeat=n):
        # Check if all values from 1 to r appear at least once
        if len(set(seq)) != r:
            continue
        
        # Check kawaii condition
        is_kawaii = True
        for k in range(2, r + 1):
            # If k appears, then k-1 must appear
            # (already checked since each value 1..r appears at least once)
            
            # first occurrence of k-1 must be before last occurrence of k
            first_k_minus_1 = seq.index(k-1)
            last_k = max(i for i, x in enumerate(seq) if x == k)
            if first_k_minus_1 >= last_k:
                is_kawaii = False
                break
        
        if is_kawaii:
            count += 1
    return count

for n in range(1, 6):
